'''Derrida''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ketton/Legends|Ketton]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in the employ of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Based on the [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]], Derrida was considered a sly, cunning adversary of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] operatives working there. Derrida earned a living by reporting [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities (such as [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Alexander Julstan IV]] of [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]] and other Imperial bureaucrats) about suspected Rebel activities. She has also worked as a spy for other people.<ref name="a" />

Derrida foiled five separate Alliance missions on the station and earned the personal enmity of Alliance operative [[Kassar Kosciusko]]. Among her work, Derrida framed [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Zhir-Khan]], falsifying records to implicate him in a betrayal of the Alliance, although her scheme eventually failed.<ref name="a" />

Rebel operative [[Lak Sivrak/Legends|Lak Sivrak]] wrote a report about Derrida, with the contribution of Kosciusko. He decided that Derrida was a clear suspect on an attempt of the life of Rebel-aligned financier Director [[Meysen Kayson|Meyser Kayson]], and he was afraid of Kayson's Rebel links being discovered if Derrida was not dealt with.<ref name="a" />

Derrida was an associate of another well-known spy, the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Garindan/Legends|Garindan]], whom she worked with on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], as reported by Kayson's son.<ref name="a" />

Derrida was finally apprehended by a team composed of [[Kyle Katarn]] and a [[Max (bunny)|pint-sized lagomorph]], who almost razed Kwenn station capturing her.<ref name="w">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>
